Name: Chaos Divers: Dissidents Among Us (test 0.29)
Description: Rebel SEAF: find the dissidents' intel and the SEAF soldiers turn on you and fight alongside the enemy holding the planet. No traitor mark, no destroyer. Your guard dog and sentries stay loyal. Co-op test build: everyone with the mod sees the same intel and takes it with E. Requires Bingus Shared Loader v15+, loaded last.
